quote: So if you like think of Open Flores like a story and it is a story, that's why it went so viral. It's like the story of like what one individual can do with a help of eye coding. The one guy, it was basically. And then eventually he got far enough where a big voluntary open source community rose around it. And so it's very inspiring to see what one person can do. And to me, Open Flores more of like an idea than an actual product. It shows us the idea of what if an agent has its own computer and you can talk to whatever you want. And you're going to see this big Renaissance, the stuff that can't be controlled, that is customized to what the user wants.
